title: Quickly Aerated Algerian Beans Tagine
description: A malty, aerated, monsoon-inspired Algerian dish featuring beans, air-fried to perfection. No onions or garlic in sight, perfect for those who prefer a lighter flavor.

ingredients.name: Malt vinegar
ingredients.notes: use in place of traditional vinegar for a richer flavor

instructions: Transfer the air fryer basket liners to the wok, as this will make cleaning up a breeze later on.
Heat the rapeseed oil in the wok over medium heat.
Once hot, add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the kidney beans to the wok and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the malt vinegar and stir to combine.
Transfer the wok to an air fryer and cook at 375°F (190°C) for 5 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
Once cooked, remove the wok from the air fryer and let cool slightly before serving.
